python.key_authorization_expiry_periodic_limit: pytempo rejects periodic token limits in key authorizations (pytempo/keychain.py:126-130, :570), which tempo-primitives and the node support.
python.reject_equal_validity_window: pytempo TempoTransaction.validate (pytempo/models.py:377-379) rejects validAfter > validBefore but not equal; tempo-primitives and the node reject equal windows too.

rust.decode_yparity_0_1: tempo-primitives AASigned decode hashes the 27/28 re-encoding, not the received bytes (crates/primitives/src/transaction/tt_signed.rs:96-104, :268). Same code as the node: see the node knownIssue on this case.
rust.reject_tip_above_fee_cap: tempo-primitives TempoTransaction::validate (tempo_transaction.rs:362) does not check maxPriorityFeePerGas <= maxFeePerGas; ox and the node reject it.

typescript.decode_reject_high_s: ox TxEnvelopeTempo.deserialize and Secp256k1.recoverAddress accept a high-s (malleable) sender signature; the node rejects it.
typescript.decode_reject_tempo_ts_fee_payer_trailer: ox TxEnvelopeTempo.deserialize accepts the legacy tempo.ts fee payer trailer; the node rejects it.
typescript.decode_reject_trailing_byte: ox TxEnvelopeTempo.deserialize ignores bytes after the RLP list; the node rejects them.
typescript.decode_reject_wrong_type: ox TxEnvelopeTempo.deserialize does not check the 0x76 type byte; the node rejects other types.
